Capacity exhaustion is selected separately by the replay CLI's tetrahedra-capacity option.
control-qualified.timing_scope: Original-coordinate canonicalization and host-to-device input staging occur before each timed update. Device copies, internal point reordering, workspace allocation on count changes, geometry work, synchronization, and state switching occur inside timing. Readback, output hashing, independent reference checking and offline motion features are outside. Sequence trials retain each backend's state across every frame; paired trials rebuild and check the previous input before timing each transition.
control-qualified.validation_scope: SciPy is a floating-point reference; the optional CGAL executable constructs and validates an exact-predicate reference. Both comparisons require tetrahedron-set equality after canonical duplicate ownership. Cospherical alternatives may legitimately differ and are reported as mismatches, not accepted as equivalent. VTM's complete runtime exact/symbolic certificate stays enabled. No public API or default changes are implied.
